workspace.control: existing EnvironmentBrain.config.correlation disabled; all observations have independent acquisition IDs
workspace.primary: paired delayed planner correct-decision rate versus independent stimulus class
workspace.disconfirmation: A cut must not be called selective if basic sensory output changes or offpath intervention causes a comparable planning loss. An identical consumer_ids list is not independent module evidence.
workspace.confidence_is: native declared environment belief, not introspective confidence

circuit.primary: change in downstream spiking after recurrent intervention versus offpath control
secondary: causal voltage spread from an actual injected pulse
circuit.disconfirmation: No reproducible downstream change means recurrence relevance is not demonstrated at these preselected inputs. Absence of spikes limits discrimination. Complexity alone is not evidence of consciousness.

analysis.confidence_interval_scope: conditional variability across designed stimulus cases; not probability of consciousness or independent physical replication
analysis.confirmatory_scope: new preregistered software-mechanism probe, not a validated phenomenal-consciousness assay

limitations: No hidden-state or weight intervention in the live ChatGPT/API language model.
The six-cell circuit and symbolic workspace are separate retained components, not one validated neural global workspace.
Existing broadcast removal forces no_shared_access by construction; its interpretation is an implementation causal dependency.
Sensor extraction and readouts are authored; no training, natural visual phenomenology or independent metacognitive observer is established.
Declared work units and update counts are controlled; hardware time and metabolic energy are not matched.
No PCI, Phi, conscious/unconscious state label or phenomenal probability is estimated.
